reviewContext.note: Fresh-context adversary review. Per the manifest's explicit instruction, iteration 1's 6 claimed fixes (FIND-001..006) were NOT accepted at face value -- every real cited source file was re-read fresh: child-spec.js + its test suite, colony-wallets.json, ensure-agent-id.mjs + its test suite, lock.mjs, is-self-funded.mjs, identity.mjs, resolve-identity.mjs, spawn-decision.js, ledger.js, gen-wallet.sh, akt-treasury.sh, economy/ubi/run.sh + ubi.js, and ~/.blockrun/mcp.json, plus the project's own on-disk canonical wallet ledger (docs/WALLETS.md). Iteration 1's 6 findings are each independently confirmed RESOLVED as claimed (REQ-105/106/206/306 are real, substantive additions, not restatements) -- FIND-001..006 are NOT re-raised. However, this pass found 4 NEW defects, one of them critical: REQ-105/305's repurposing of colony-wallets.json as the surplus-aggregation registry does not address that the file's current 2nd entry is claude-p's own human-funded wallet (confirmed via docs/WALLETS.md), directly threatening the same HARD invariant this feature exists to enforce. Two further findings show REQ-206 (the FIND-001 fix) and REQ-103 (the FIND-003 fix) each contain their own new internal ambiguity/contradiction not caught before this pass.
